# BuildHub

> Mobile marketplace connecting construction workers, teams, suppliers, and clients across Cambodia.

BuildHub helps homeowners, contractors, and companies post construction projects,
find skilled workers and teams, and discover material suppliers. The app is bilingual
(Khmer and English) and optimized for mobile.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Welcome page — register or sign in to start finding work or workers.
- [Help & FAQ](/help): Answers to common questions about accounts, posting jobs, applying, and messaging.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How BuildHub collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): Terms governing use of the BuildHub platform.
